final: WITH genders AS (SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM Customers), counts AS (SELECT g.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM genders g LEFT JOIN Customers c ON c.gender = g.gender LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.date_order_placed BETWEEN '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY g.gender), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT counts.gender, counts.order_count, counts.order_count - avg_c.avg_count AS above_avg FROM counts, avg_c WHERE counts.order_count > avg_c.avg_count
